entry_state: Arelle display,equality,duplicate and reduction methods answer different questions;pairwise overlap does not establish whole-set consistency. Original occurrences survive reduced views. Apple's selected annual and interim balances agree under bounded checks while duplicate equity locations remain separate and scale/sign are applied once. The first optional importer selects native Arelle with pdfplumber as a separate comparator. Source selection,environment resolution and executed compatibility are distinct. Shared declared constraints require Pillow>=12.2,<13 and exclude Python3.8/3.9,but do not establish an installed environment. Chapter13 ends354;acceptance starts355.
exit_state: Engineering conformance,accounting validity and scientific forecasting require separate evidence. Core cases include balanced-but-wrong counterexamples and preserve unsupported outcomes. The DSL comparator uses the same typed IR and tasks. Forecast comparisons require equal information,uncertainty and retained failed predictions. The nine-issuer corpus is developmental;192 reports are not independent and exact-byte availability remains required. E1 evaluates source preservation,E2 bounded reconstruction and conditional accounting. E3 introduces first-release operating cash flow and a joint secondary vector;its comparator discussion continues after360.

findings.observation: Conformance cases test semantic and identity failures as well as arithmetic. They do not claim production or unrestricted historical completeness.
Forecast evaluation distinguishes an invalid experiment from a rejected candidate and requires comparisons against credible simple and tuned baselines.
The information-date protocol rejects training leakage and partially elapsed periods mislabeled as wholly future forecasts. E1 and E2 specify distinct references and denominators.
